skill.name: frontend-design
skill.description: Create polished frontend components, pages, and applications with a distinctive visual direction and production-focused implementation.
skill.summary: Turn frontend requirements into functional, visually distinctive interfaces.
skill.author: am-will

content.value_statement: Generic interface patterns make products difficult to distinguish. This skill turns requirements into functional frontend code with deliberate typography, color, layout, and motion.
actual_capabilities: Implements frontend components, pages, and applications in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Vue, or another requested stack.
Defines a clear visual direction based on purpose, audience, tone, and technical constraints.
Coordinates typography, color variables, spacing, composition, backgrounds, and decorative details.
Adds purposeful animations, page-load sequences, hover states, and other micro-interactions.
Matches implementation complexity to either restrained minimalism or detailed maximalism.
limitations: The skill provides design and implementation guidance, not bundled components, image assets, or automated testing.
Output quality depends on clear requirements for audience, purpose, framework, content, and constraints.
Accessibility, performance, and browser compatibility still require project-specific verification.
Requested frameworks, fonts, and motion libraries must be available in the working environment.

use_cases.title: Launch a Product Page
use_cases.description: Create a responsive product page with a clear brand direction, polished interactions, and production-ready structure.

use_cases.title: Build an Application Interface
use_cases.description: Implement a cohesive dashboard or application workflow in the existing frontend stack.

use_cases.title: Refresh a Visual System
use_cases.description: Translate a creative brief into stronger typography, color, composition, backgrounds, and motion.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Responsive Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a responsive page for [product] using [framework]. Use [brand colors], clear hierarchy, accessible controls, and a distinctive [tone] aesthetic.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when starting a focused page from a short brief.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Complete Component
prompt_templates.prompt: Design and implement a [component] for [users] in [framework]. Include responsive behavior, keyboard access, and loading, empty, error, and success states.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when a reusable interface element needs complete interaction states.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Cohesive Application
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a [application type] for [audience] using [stack]. Define a bold visual direction, reusable tokens, responsive layouts, and purposeful motion. Preserve [constraints].
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for a multi-view product that needs consistent design and implementation.

prompt_templates.title: Audit and Redesign an Existing Frontend
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit the frontend at [path] and redesign [scope] without changing business logic. Improve hierarchy, accessibility, responsiveness, performance, and interaction states. Verify with tests and screenshots.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for an advanced redesign within an established codebase.

output_examples.input: Create a responsive launch page for a privacy-focused calendar application with a refined editorial style.
output: A complete launch page with clear product positioning and responsive sections.
An editorial type system, restrained color palette, and consistent design tokens.
Purposeful page-load motion, hover feedback, and accessible interactive controls.

output_examples.input: Build an operations dashboard for a logistics team using the existing React project.
output: A dense, scannable dashboard aligned with the existing component patterns.
Responsive data views with loading, empty, error, and populated states.
Clear status colors, action hierarchy, filters, and keyboard-accessible controls.

output_examples.input: Redesign a portfolio homepage with a bold geometric direction while preserving its content.
output: A distinctive composition that preserves the original information and navigation.
A coordinated typography, color, spacing, and background system.
Responsive layouts and focused motion that support the geometric concept.

best_practices: Provide the audience, purpose, framework, content, brand constraints, and required interaction states.
Choose one clear visual direction and apply it consistently across typography, color, layout, and motion.
Verify responsiveness, accessibility, performance, and visual rendering in the target environment.
anti_patterns: Do not request a generic interface without product context, audience needs, or technical constraints.
Do not combine unrelated visual styles or add effects that weaken hierarchy and usability.
Do not treat generated code as complete before testing interactions, breakpoints, accessibility, and browser behavior.

faq.question: What can this skill create?
faq.answer: It can create frontend components, pages, applications, and interface redesigns in the requested web technology.

faq.question: Which frameworks does it support?
faq.answer: The guidance supports HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Vue, and other frontend stacks specified in the request.

faq.question: Can it follow an existing design system?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the design tokens, component conventions, assets, and codebase constraints that the implementation must preserve.

faq.question: Does it guarantee accessible output?
faq.answer: No. It can implement accessible patterns, but the result still needs keyboard, screen reader, contrast, and semantic markup testing.

faq.question: Can it improve an existing interface?
faq.answer: Yes. Identify the files, business logic, visual problems, and behaviors that must remain unchanged.

faq.question: What information produces the best result?
faq.answer: Provide the purpose, target users, content, preferred stack, brand direction, required states, breakpoints, and acceptance criteria.
